verdict.rationale: Bolt offers a built-in GitHub MCP connector for code search/issues/discussions, showing some MCP plug-in capability, but there is no evidence of a general mechanism for users to add arbitrary/custom MCP servers so the AI can use their tools. missing for 10: general-purpose MCP server configuration UI/API, support for third-party or user-defined MCP servers beyond GitHub, documentation on adding custom tool servers, independent confirmation of MCP tool usage in practice.
